State-resolved Itô-generator equations yield w2=2D(2K-Q^T)^{-1}pi, w4=12D(4K-Q^T)^{-1}w2 and C(t)=1^T exp((Q^T-K)t)w2. Its fixed initial slope C'(0+)=-D and Cayley-Hamilton reduce pure exponential covariance to an exact positive-prefactor factorization F=0. Solving F=0 with alpha,beta>0 uniquely gives k1<rho<k2 and the two explicit rates. ODE uniqueness proves all lags. Exact fourth-moment elimination yields a strictly positive fourth cumulant for every interior parameter. Algebraic identities were independently replayed from packaged verify.py with 229 symbolic/exact-rational checks, including an off-resonance control; finite checks are not substituted for analytical global quantifiers.

value.rationale: A natural inverse question for an experimental switching confinement model has an exhaustive answer: complete population covariance at every lag cannot exclude hidden stiffness switching even with matching diffusion, because every fixed effective OU relaxation rate supports a two-dimensional family of observationally identical but non-Gaussian models. A closed strictly positive fourth cumulant gives a specific distinguishing higher-order statistic. This is a nontrivial structural classification and cancellation manifold, not a generic moment plug-in or arbitrary parameter slice. The result is ideal-population only, with no noisy-data recovery claim.
